Forced turn to object behavior
Controls when your character is forced to turn towards objects during a world interaction.
Enable off-hand animations
Poses the item held in the off hand instead of leaving it to the vanilla animation. <LINE> Turn this off if you use another animation mod such as Tactical Hold and the two fight over the left arm.
Firearm aim animation change level
Aiming skill at which the character switches to the tactical aiming animation. <LINE> Set to 0 to always use it. Set to 11 to never use it.
Hide vehicle door action progress bar
Hides the progress bar shown while opening or closing a vehicle door, and while entering or exiting a vehicle.
Hide vehicle 'walk to' action progress bar
Hides the progress bar shown while the character walks over to a vehicle to interact with it.
Never do rear animations
Do rear animations until turn delay
Always do rear animations
Rear action animation behavior

How often the character reaches behind instead of turning around. <LINE> The character still turns towards objects that have no rear animation, unless forced turning is disabled. <LINE> Turn delay or disabled turning must be selected for rear animations to appear - 'Always do forced turn' prevents them.
Forced turn delay
While standing still, the character turns to face the object being interacted with after this many seconds. <LINE> Requires the turn delay option to be enabled.
